profile.ja:
五車学園の学生対魔忍。
苦無や手裏剣などを自由自在に操る“磁遁の術”を用いる。
おしゃべりで落ち着きがない好奇心旺盛な性格だが、入学以前の経歴が存在しないミステリアスな生徒。
その正体は学生たちの訓練用木人に宿った付喪神で、若き対魔忍たちの汗と涙、思念などが依り集まって具現化した存在である。
磁遁は木人であった頃のカラクリを利用して磁界を作り出し、領域内の道具を操作するというもの。
具現化したのは最近なので、人間社会の習わしについては木人時代に聞きかじったことしか知らず、目下勉強中。
同級生と仲良くなるためにパソコンや携帯電話などの電子機器と同調して使いこなそうとしているが、あまり上手くいかず故障させがちである。
人外であることは秘密にしているものの、対魔忍上層部には見抜かれている。
しかし、無害な気質であることから見逃されているようだ。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin student at Gosha Academy, utilizing the "magnetic evasion technique" to freely manipulate items like shuriken. She has a talkative and curious personality, but her history before enrolling in the academy is shrouded in mystery. Her true identity is that of a tsukumogami, a spirit that inhabits a training dummy used by students, born from the sweat, tears, and thoughts of young Taimanin. The magnetic evasion technique utilizes the mechanical workings of the training dummy to create a magnetic field, allowing her to manipulate tools within its range. Having recently come into existence, she is still learning about human society, only knowing what she overheard during her time as a training dummy. She is trying to befriend her classmates by using electronic devices like computers and phones, but often ends up breaking them. Her non-human nature is a secret, but it seems the higher-ups in the Taimanin organization are aware of it and are choosing to overlook it due to her harmless nature.

text.ja: わたし、摸守つくも。正体は訓練用木人に宿った付喪神だね。みんなにはナイショだよ。あなただけの秘密がいいかな？　かな？
text.en: I'm Mogami Tsukumo. My true identity is a tsukumogami, a spirit that inhabits a training dummy. It's a secret, just between you and me, okay? Would you like to keep it that way?

text.ja: 新しくなったこの身体、柔らかくて、暖かくて、動きやすくて、なんだかとっても愉快だね、ね
text.en: This new body of mine is so soft, warm, and easy to move around in - it's really wonderful, isn't it?

text.ja: わたし、おしゃべり大好き、食べるのも大好き、眠るのも大好き。木人（もくじん）の時にはできなかったかな、かな
text.en: I love to talk, eat, and sleep. I couldn't do any of those things when I was just a training dummy, could I?

text.ja: もぐもぐごっくん。わたしが喋ってるとみんなオヤツをくれるんだ。なんでかな？　かな？　え？　あなたもくれるの？　ごちそうさま
text.en: Munch munch, gulp. Whenever I talk, everyone gives me snacks. Why is that? Do you think you'd give me some too? Thanks for the treat.

text.ja: 目が開きっぱなし？　いけないいけない。まばたきはつい忘れちゃうんだ。だって元が木人（もくじん）だからね
text.en: My eyes are wide open, aren't they? I guess I forget to blink sometimes. That's because I used to be a training dummy, after all.

text.ja: 髪を整えるのは苦手だね。この身体はとっても静電気がよく溜まるんだ。でもボサボサがわたしに似合ってるね、ね
text.en: I'm not very good at styling my hair. This body of mine tends to build up static electricity really easily. But I think the messy look suits me, don't you?

text.ja: 若き対魔忍の血と汗と涙、それがわたしが生まれたきっかけだよ。あなたもゆっくりまったり死ぬ気で頑張ろうね、ね
text.en: The blood, sweat, and tears of young Taimanin - those are what brought me into this world. Let's take it easy and do our best, shall we?

text.ja: 元が忍具だから苦無でも手裏剣でも自由自在に操れるよ。でもパソコンやスマホは苦手だね。複雑な道具はすぐ壊れるよ
text.en: Since I used to be a tool, I can manipulate shuriken and other items with ease. But I'm not very good with computers or smartphones - complicated devices like those tend to break easily when I use them.

text.ja: ハァハァ、木人のわたしがちゃんとセックスできるなんてびっくりだね……ハァハア、肉の疼きが新鮮だよ。だよ
text.en: Ha ha, I'm still surprised that I, a former training dummy, can have sex... Ha ha, the sensations of my new body are so refreshing.

text.ja: アアンッ、わたしでも子供ができるかもしれないよ……試してみる価値はおおありかな。かなあっ。いっぱい出して欲しいね。ねっ
text.en: Ah, I wonder if I could get pregnant too... It might be worth a try, don't you think? I'd love it if you could fill me up.

text.ja: 木人から生身の身体になったのにっ、またチンポを悦ばせる道具になるなんてぇっ、とってもとっても嬉しいよっ、アアンッ！！
text.en: I've gone from being a training dummy to a living, breathing body, and now I get to be a tool for your pleasure again... It's just so wonderful, ah!
